To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have developed a framework for mining rules from RDF data that is based on a state-of-the-art rule mining algorithm and has been extended with a number of useful features.

we have designed a framework for mining rules in RDF knowledge graphs.
